tooltip.another_quarries.quarry.desc1: Supply RF and install drones, drills, and modules.
tooltip.another_quarries.drone.desc: Adds one extra mining worker when installed in a quarry.
tooltip.another_quarries.drill_diamond.d: Diamond-tier quarry drill. Faster mining and higher mining level.
tooltip.another_quarries.drill_netherite: Netherite-tier quarry drill. Best mining speed and level.
tooltip.another_quarries.module_speed.de: Increases quarry mining speed. Stackable in the speed module slot.
tooltip.another_quarries.module_digger.d: Speeds up breaking non-ore blocks. Stackable in the digger module slot.
Adds Fortune to quarry output. Stackable in the enchant module slot.
tooltip.another_quarries.module_silktouc: Mines blocks with Silk Touch when installed in the enchant module slot.
tooltip.another_quarries.module_filter.d: Destroys quarry drops matching the destroy list.
Install in the filter slot. Right-click with this item in hand to edit the destroy list. Shift-click a quarry to install.
Single-stack module for Fortune or Silk Touch via anvil. Mutually exclusive with fortune/silk stack modules.
gui.another_quarries.quarry.reboot.toolt: Rebuild the quarry frame from scratch and reset mining progress
gui.another_quarries.quarry.preview.tool: Show or hide the mining area outline

Mines one chunk at a time within the configured area
